## Short companions

Small, lecture-specific notebooks remain available as source downloads under [`notebooks/`](https://github.com/nipunbatra/dl-teaching/tree/master/notebooks). Use them when the deck points to one; they are not rendered as separate public pages.

## Before an assignment

Open the notebook that the assignment names, restart it, and run it top to bottom. A result you cannot reproduce or explain is not yet useful evidence for your submission.
